stem.text: A box of length $12\,\text{cm}$ and weight $0.43\,\text{N}$ is placed on a horizontal table, with the greater part of its length overhanging the edge of the table. The edge of the table acts as a pivot. The centre of gravity of the box is at its geometric centre.
To balance the box, a uniform sphere of diameter $2.4\,\text{cm}$ is placed inside the box, touching one end, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a box resting on a table with its edge acting as a pivot, and a sphere inside the box touching one end. The labels show 12 cm for the length of the box, 2.4 cm for the diameter of the sphere, and box, sphere, table and edge of table (pivot).

stem.text: Assume that the forces acting on the box are in the plane of the diagram.
What is the minimum mass of the sphere that is needed to maintain the system in equilibrium?
